dataSource.select:
SELECT IMP.IMPR_NBR IMPR_NBR, IS_1.SUSPN_SEQ SUSPN_SEQ, IMP.BUS_ID BUS_ID, IMP.CTRY_CD CTRY_CD, IS_1.PORT_CD PORT_CD, IS_1.IMPR_NBR IMPR_NBR2, IS_1.SUSPN_RSN_CD SUSPN_RSN_CD, IMP.ARBC_IMPR_NAME ARBC_IMPR_NAME, IS_1.SUSPN_SIDE_CD SUSPN_SIDE_CD, IMP.BUS_ID_BRNCH BUS_ID_BRNCH, IMP.CITY_CODE IMP_CITY_CODE, IS_1.SUSPN_STRT_DT SUSPN_STRT_DT, IS_1.SUSPN_END_DT SUSPN_END_DT, IS_1.SUSPN_RLSE_DT SUSPN_RLSE_DT, IS_1.SUSPN_RSN_TEXT SUSPN_RSN_TEXT FROM IMPORTERS IMP, IMPR_SUSPNS IS_1 WHERE IS_1.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR AND IS_1.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD &CG$P_IMPR_NBR --(:CG$P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL OR IMP.IMPR_NBR = :CG$P_IMPR_NBR) AND AND (:P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL OR IS_1.PORT_CD = :P_CURR_PORT_CD)
AND
( ((:C_DATE BETWEEN SUSPN_STRT_DT AND SUSPN_END_DT)
AND SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NULL AND (:P_TYPE = 2 OR :P_TYPE = 3))
OR
(((:C_DATE NOT BETWEEN SUSPN_STRT_DT AND SUSPN_END_DT)
OR SUSPN_RLSE_DT IS NOT NULL) AND (:P_TYPE = 1 OR :P_TYPE = 3)) )
